builtin.Bash: shell commands: git, gh, xcodegen, xcodebuild, scripts
builtin.ToolSearch: loading MCP tool schemas on demand

xcode.RenderPreview: render #Preview to PNG for UI checks and docs/screenshots (incl. dark mode override)
xcode.XcodeCloseWorkspace: close the project before moving it to src/ios

ccd_turn.update_plan: task list shown in the desktop app
ccd_turn.wrap_up: end-of-turn summary in the desktop app

Claude_Browser.navigate: open local pages in the built-in browser
Claude_Browser.browser_batch: navigate + wait + read in one call
Claude_Browser.javascript_tool: inspect the page while checking diagrams
Claude_Browser.computer (screenshot, scroll): visual check of rendered mermaid diagrams

Claude_Code_iOS_Simulator.control: attach / launch / detach: show the app in the simulator panel

cli.gh: auth status, repo create, gitignore template, package release lookups via gh api
cli.xcodebuild: build the app and run iOS tests on the existing simulator
cli.xcrun simctl: list, boot, uninstall/launch/terminate the app, shutdown; 'spawn … log show' for the app's os_log lines; 'get_app_container' to read saved preferences
cli.swift: toolchain version, SwiftPM layout check, package resolve / build / test / run for the server (also as the local server for simulator checks)
cli.curl: inspect Frankfurter responses and edge cases; live checks of the server API incl. If-None-Match / 304; Docker Hub tag lookup; healthcheck command
cli.python3: multi-line source edits, extracting mermaid blocks, local http.server for checks
cli.sqlite3: inspect the server database: stored days, sync_runs, journal mode
cli.lsof: check that a port is free; find a server PID by port
cli.pkill: stop the local server and hung xcodebuild
cli.ruby: parse docker-compose.yml as YAML (no Docker available)
cli.kill: send SIGTERM to imitate docker stop
cli.docker: NOT available on this machine (not installed); scripts/verify-docker.sh is ready for when it is
cli.plutil: read Info.plist of the built app and the app's preferences plist in the simulator

frameworks_for_tests.VaporTesting: in-process HTTP tests of the server endpoints

test_destination: existing iPhone 17 Pro simulator (D6B088C2), reused for tests and manual checks, never created by the agent, shut down afterwards

instructions.project: CLAUDE.md: log every request in .agent/prompt-log.md, every agent mistake in .agent/errors.md, keep this file in sync
user_global: Personal projects: commit straight to main and push, no PRs or feature branches
SwiftUI UI checks: render #Preview via Xcode MCP instead of running the app
iOS simulators: reuse an existing free simulator, never create new ones, shut down after use
